Class NanoHttpdServerDemo

java.lang.Object
fi.iki.elonen.NanoHTTPD
org.newsclub.net.unix.demo.nanohttpd.NanoHttpdServerDemo
public final class NanoHttpdServerDemo extends fi.iki.elonen.NanoHTTPD
Creates a NanoHTTPD server, bound to /tmp/junixsocket-http-server.sock. Http requests on that socket should return "Hello world from <hostname>".
Author:
Christian Kohlschütter
